panels.title: Sentry — engineering diagnostics
panels.summary: Crash reporting. Deliberately kept separate from product analytics: different purpose, different data, different gates.

metrics.label: Crash reporting (Sentry)
metrics.note: Three independent gates must all be satisfied by --dart-define and none is set in any release build: CRASH_REPORTING_ENABLED, a structurally valid SENTRY_DSN, and CRASH_REPORTING_PRODUCTION_APPROVED (required because the bundled .env declares production).

metrics.label: DSN present in the build
metrics.note: The DSN can only arrive via --dart-define. It is absent from .env, from source and from the verified 215 binaries.

metrics.label: Crash-free session rate
metrics.note: Automatic session tracking is deliberately switched off, so no crash-free rate exists for any build. This figure cannot be produced until Sentry is enabled AND session tracking is separately approved.

metrics.label: Native crash capture
metrics.note: Native envelopes bypass the beforeSend sanitiser, so native crash handling is switched off by design. Native fatals are therefore not reported even once Sentry is enabled.

panels.title: Telemetry — product analytics
panels.summary: Anonymous aggregate product usage. Never symptoms, answers, results or location.

metrics.label: Product analytics (telemetry)
metrics.note: Two gates, both false in the bundled .env. There is also no TELEMETRY_BASE_URL, which fails the config closed independently.

metrics.label: Events received
metrics.note: No events are emitted by any build. "0 events" would wrongly imply a working pipeline reporting no activity.

metrics.label: Analytics consent decision
metrics.note: Unresolved. Owner: Product / Privacy. Required before any external cohort. No consent flow exists in the app.

metrics.label: Telemetry backend endpoint
metrics.note: The staging backend returns 503 telemetry_disabled. The endpoint is not accepting events, by the backend's own configuration.

actions.title: CB_211 clinical adjudication
actions.note: The one open finding in the 239-case bank. Blocks every external cohort — closed beta, public beta and production. Does not block internal testing.

actions.title: Designate a monitored support mailbox
actions.note: Required on both store listings. Must not be a personal address. Cannot be created by engineering.

actions.title: Publish the privacy policy at a stable public URL
actions.note: Required by Play for all apps and doubly so under the Health Apps declaration. Must state that symptom data never leaves the device.

actions.title: Enrol in Play App Signing at the next upload opportunity
actions.note: The upload key exists on exactly one machine with no escrowed backup. Losing it without Play App Signing would end the ability to update the listing.

actions.title: Escrow the replacement Apple Distribution private key
actions.note: The original private key was unrecoverable and a replacement certificate was issued on 2026-09-25. Exporting a .p12 to secure storage now prevents an identical loss.

actions.title: Physical-device smoke test of build 215 on both platforms
actions.note: Emulator and CI runs do not substitute. iOS is blocked until TestFlight processing completes.

actions.title: Reconcile the contradictory Sentry DPA records
actions.note: One document says the DPA is pending acceptance; the other says it was signed and effective 2026-09-21. The later record appears to supersede, but the earlier was never updated. This must be settled before Sentry is enabled, not after.

actions.title: Decide whether analytics consent is required
actions.note: Unresolved. Required before any external cohort if telemetry is ever enabled. The config plumbing for a runtime consent gate already exists.

actions.title: Correct the stale crash-provider claim in the telemetry doc
actions.note: Both still state that no crash provider exists and that stack traces are not forwarded. Sentry landed afterwards and stack traces are forwarded, sanitised per frame.

actions.title: Update CLAUDE.md to the real toolchain
actions.note: Declares Flutter 3.41.5 / Dart 3.11.3; the actual toolchain is Flutter 3.44.4 / Dart 3.12.2.
